claims.claim: Used 3 Seaters and 2 Seaters Couch going for giveaway price
claims.evidence: All three photos show only a single 3-seater tufted sofa from different angles; no 2-seater couch appears in any image, so that part of the claim cannot be checked.
No close-up of fabric wear, stains, sagging, or underside is provided; only clean front/angled shots on a staged floor.
Pricing claims are not something a photo can confirm or deny; this is a seller assertion, not a visual fact.

risks.risk: The advertised 2-seater sofa may not exist or may differ from the 3-seater shown.
risks.proof: A photo or short video showing the 2-seater sofa alongside or near the 3-seater, ideally in the same room with both visible together.
risks.if_unproven: Price only the single 3-seater sofa that is actually documented; treat the 2-seater as not for sale/unconfirmed.

risks.risk: Fabric material and quality (velvet vs cheap polyester) affecting durability and value.
risks.proof: Close-up macro shot of the fabric weave/texture.

risks.risk: Hidden stains, tears, or sagging under cushions.
risks.proof: Photo with cushions removed showing base and underside of fabric.
risks.if_unproven: Price as heavily used with possible hidden damage.

risks.risk: Frame material and structural soundness (wood vs weak particleboard, leg attachment integrity).
risks.proof: Photo of the underside/frame joints and a short clip of someone pressing on the seat or legs to show stability.
risks.if_unproven: Price as structurally unverified, worst-case wobbly/weak frame.

risks.risk: Odor or smoke/pet exposure, which photos cannot capture.
risks.proof: Seller verbal/video disclosure or a close video walkthrough is not conclusive, but a buyer in-person sniff test is the only real proof.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially odor-affected (no discount removed until buyer inspects in person).

risks.risk: Age and cumulative wear not apparent from staged angles.
risks.proof: Timestamped photos or a date-of-purchase receipt if available.

proof_requests: Separate clear photos of the 2-seater couch (same angles as the 3-seater).
Photo with seat cushions removed showing base, frame, and underside.
Photo of leg attachment points and a short clip pressing/rocking the sofa to test stability.
Any receipt or purchase date documentation, if available.
response.reason: The witness only confirms one used 3-seater tufted sofa; the claimed 2-seater is unverifiable from the report, so price only the documented 3-seater at its worst-case condition pending further proof.
